name: Sweet 'n' Sour Pork with Broccoli, Carrot & Bell Pepper over Rice
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; add to the bowl with the broccoli.
Peel, trim, and halve carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin pieces; add to the bowl.
Trim green onions and mince the white parts; add to the bowl. Cut green parts crosswise into ¼-inch pieces and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add sausage and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer sausage to a plate (leaving drippings in the skillet) and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, place ketchup, vinegar, sugar, Worcestershire, and salt in a small bowl; whisk to combine the sauce.
Once the sausage is done, return the skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat; add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
When the veggies are done, return cooked sausage to the skillet; add sauce, stir to combine, and cook until sauce is warmed through and sausage is coated, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice, sweet 'n' sour pork, and veggies between plates or bowls; top with reserved green onions. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
